title: Idol Solo 087 · 콜로설(한국 아이돌 실버폭스) · 청자 상감 · 기대고 앉기
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation illustration, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

Style: A high-quality Japanese anime key visual illustration, clean cel shading, crisp confident line art, vibrant saturated colors, polished professional anime art — not a photograph.

Subject: ONE mature adult woman, a Korean woman in her mid 40s, with clearly adult facial features, with the polished look of a K-pop idol, fair ivory skin with a warm golden undertone, smooth high cheekbones with a gently tapering jaw and a small delicate chin, large clear dark eyes with a soft double lid, straight softly arched brows, a slender nose and full rounded lips, a pair of long dangling drop earrings, a striking silver-haired beauty, her hair turned early — her face still young and firm with only the faintest lines at the outer corners of her eyes, a full head of natural silver-white hair in a sharp blunt bob with a straight centre part, a serene composed expression.

Body Art: Full body Korean celadon inlay body painting on her bare skin from the collarbones to the ankles, a soft pale jade-green glaze ground inlaid with crisp white and black slip cranes, clouds and chrysanthemum medallions, fine double-line bands following the deep crease beneath every roll and circling the arms and thighs. The pattern covers the entire bust densely with no open gaps, and wraps fully around the rear, the lower belly and the calves, covering them as densely as the chest. Every roll keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass.

Physique: EXTREME COLOSSAL physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE, exaggerated far beyond real anatomy, around 1,000 pounds, her body so wide that her shoulders are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame — a giantess built on a completely even scale, every part of her enlarged by the same amount: massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full bust, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, enormous columnar thighs and thick heavy calves, her shoulders spanning more than four head-widths, each hand as wide as a normal woman's torso. No single part stands out more than another, no hanging rolls, not pregnant.

Pose: Propped against a padded backrest on a low platform at about 45 degrees with her legs stretched out in front of her and slightly apart, her outer arm resting back on the platform behind her hip with the elbow out and her other hand on her own thigh, neither arm crossing in front of her torso, her face turned to the camera, full body head to toe. The mass of her middle spills forward down the slope of her raised torso and piles over the tops of her thighs.

Footwear: Extreme pale jade-green platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: A dark deep-navy stylized background, a single strong warm light from one side, deep soft shadows in every crease and beneath every hanging roll, the pale glaze glowing and the inlaid cranes reading crisp, glossy anime highlights on every curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body illustration, taller than it is wide.
